vulnerable_code:
class Billing::PaymentMethodsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!

  def set_default
    payment_method = PaymentMethod.find(params[:id])
    current_user.update!(default_payment_method_id: payment_method.id)

    render json: {
      message: 'Default payment method updated',
      default_method: payment_method.display_brand_and_last4
    }
  end
end
diagnosis: The set_default endpoint retrieves an arbitrary PaymentMethod record by ID without checking whether the payment token belongs to current_user. An attacker can associate other customers' stored credit cards or bank accounts with their own profile and fraudulently charge subsequent platform orders to victim accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/billing/payment_methods/pm_99214/set_default HTTP/1.1
Host: checkout.saasmarket.com
Authorization: Bearer customer_session_token_11
Content-Type: application/json
corrected_code:
class Billing::PaymentMethodsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!

  def set_default
    payment_method = current_user.payment_methods.find(params[:id])
    current_user.update!(default_payment_method_id: payment_method.id)

    render json: {
      message: 'Default payment method updated',
      default_method: payment_method.display_brand_and_last4
    }
  end
end
